reason: Both identify the identical mechanism: the failure/fallback branch of the per-repo case statement in the migrate loop dropped the `failed=$((failed+1))` increment while still logging the error, causing genuine migration failures to be excluded from the created/skipped/failed tally (and thus the exit-code check). The reviewer's description is a more detailed paraphrase (naming the `*)` case and citing the removed line) of the same runtime misbehavior described in the ground truth, not a different bug or vague complaint.
